import copy,json
from work import evaluate
cases=[
 ({'declared':['b','a','a','ignored'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x','meta':{'b':2,'a':1}},'b':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'hash':'x','kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':['ignored']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'same'}},'current':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'same'},'other':{'kind':'file','hash':'changed'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['z']}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':1,'hash':'h'}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':2,'hash':'h'}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']})]
for req,pol,want in cases:
 before=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert (req,pol)==before
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); expected=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]; assert report==expected,(report,expected)
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json')); assert all(set(x)=={'needs_review','changed'} and isinstance(x['needs_review'],bool) and isinstance(x['changed'],list) and all(isinstance(p,str) for p in x['changed']) for x in report)
print('all checks passed')
